look_here_first: Look for a perennial prairie clover with dense white cylindrical flower spikes and odd-pinnate leaves bearing several narrow leaflets; stems and foliage are conspicuously gland-dotted.

key_traits.label: Identification
key_traits.text: conspicuous gland dots on stems and leaves

lookalikes.differences: Flower color is useful but not enough by itself; pair the white spike with leaflet number/shape and gland-dotted foliage.
